message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to your system clock, but you can check the current time right from the Windows command prompt with a single command:

```cmd
echo %time%
```

Running that will print something like:

```
14:32:07.45
```

If you need the date as well, use:

```cmd
echo %date% %time%
```

That will give you the full timestamp (e.g., `07/06/2026 14:32:07.45`).
